purpose: Generic isolated query-slot gate with explicit selected-dataset context; subjects are fixtures, while tasks measure reusable relational operations.

tasks.pattern: filter, derive a comparable percentage, rank
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT district, ROUND(100.0 * children_fully_immunised / children_due, 1) AS coverage_percent FROM immunisation WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY coverage_percent DESC, district
phrasings: 2023 only show full immunisation percent district wise highest first
for 2023 compare districts by fully immunised out of children due, top to bottom
make district list for 2023 full immunisation coverage percentage and sort best first
only year 2023. calculate fully immunised percentage for each district descending
which districts have higher full immunisation coverage in 2023? give all in order

tasks.gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
phrasings: for Gaya and Nalanda how many percentage points ANC coverage changed from 2021 to 2023
compare 2021 with 2023 for Gaya and Nalanda, percentage-point change in ANC4 completed divided by registered
give district wise ANC percentage-point increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
2021 to 2023 ANC coverage movement for these two: Gaya, Nalanda
calculate 2023 ANC coverage rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda

tasks.gold_sql: SELECT district, ROUND(100.0 * employed_at_6_months / women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY employment_percent ASC, district
phrasings: 2023 employment after 6 months as percent of enrolled, lowest district first
show all districts 2023 employed divided by women enrolled as a percentage, ascending
which district has lower employed out of enrolled rate in 2023? list everyone low to high
for 2023 calculate employment percentage for each district using enrolled as base and sort smallest
district wise 2023 employed at 6 months over enrolled rate, worst first

tasks.pattern: filter two periods and groups, derive two percentages
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT district, year, ROUND(100.0 * institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS delivery_percent, ROUND(100.0 * postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS postnatal_percent FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY district, year
phrasings: Gaya and Nalanda 2022 2023 show institutional delivery and postnatal percentages of registrations
compare Gaya and Nalanda for 2022 and 2023: institutional delivery and 48-hour postnatal rates over registered pregnancies
only Gaya Nalanda and years 2022-2023. calculate delivery coverage and postnatal coverage over registrations
for Gaya and Nalanda in 2022 and 2023 give two percentages: institutional deliveries and 48 hour checks over registrations
for Gaya Nalanda show registered pregnancy based rates for delivery and postnatal, 2022 to 2023

tasks.pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
tasks.reference: The selected tables have the same district-year grain and can be matched on district and year. Percent means 100.0 times numerator divided by the stated denominator.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
phrasings: match the two tables for 2023 and show each district ANC completed over registered percent with employed over enrolled percent
join ANC visits and livelihoods by district and year, 2023 ANC and employment rates side by side
for 2023 combine both files and calculate ANC coverage and employed out of enrolled percentage for each district
district wise 2023: ANC completed over registered and employed over enrolled as percentages from both tables
put 2023 ANC coverage and employment percentages together, matching district and year

tasks.pattern: null detection without treating missing as zero
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT region, period FROM quality_observations WHERE quality_score IS NULL ORDER BY region, period
phrasings: show region and period where quality score is missing, don't treat blank as zero
which rows have no quality score? only region and period
list the places and years with blank quality score
find missing quality_score records and give region and period
quality score not available where? show region and period only
